title: fix: extend reported-issue quest lookback to 90 days
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Extends the fixed pre-launch cutoff from August 24 to June 25, 2026.
- Keeps the reward at 2 Quest Pollen per qualifying issue.
- Updates the cutoff boundary test.
- Current GitHub audit: 42 eligible issues from 15 linked reporters, up to 84 Pollen.

Local targeted Vitest could not start because this checkout lacks @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers; PR CI will run the full Enter suite.

gist.headline: More old bugs, more pollen
gist.blurb: The reported-issue quest now looks further back through the garden ledger. Qualifying GitHub issues from the extended window can still bloom into 2 Quest Pollen each.
gist.summary: Extended the reported-issue Quest’s fixed pre-launch cutoff from August 24 to June 25, 2026, preserving the 2 Quest Pollen reward for each qualifying linked GitHub issue.
gist.impact: Linked reporters can now have older qualifying issues recognized in the Quest window; the current GitHub audit finds 42 eligible issues across 15 reporters, worth up to 84 Pollen.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful quest keeper extending a cozy garden calendar backward to uncover previously overlooked GitHub issue flowers, each tagged with a tiny 2 Pollen reward. A CRT monitor robot can help audit the issue ledger while vines and code-plants make the expanded history feel like a healthy garden rather than paperwork.
